title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling well overall and denies any recent symptoms such as edema, fatigue, or changes in urine output. He has been compliant with his current medication regimen and reports regular blood pressure readings at home. He is here today for a laboratory review and a clinical assessment of his renal function.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable. Physical examination reveals no peripheral edema and no signs of uremic frost. Heart sounds are regular. Lungs are clear to auscultation. Skin is intact with no visible lesions.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 1. The patient remains stable at this time with no acute changes in renal function.

Plan
1. Continue current medications as prescribed.
2. Order repeat serum creatinine and BUN to monitor progression of chronic kidney disease.
3. Follow up in six months for repeat laboratory evaluation.
